    Push-downs from convex pieces of the universal cover #

    Let S be a finite convex set of objects of the universal cover P̃ of a finite ray category P, and X a representation of the piece D_S that satisfies the relations of P̃ (paths with zero composite act by zero, paths with the same composite act equally). Then the push-down p_*X is a module over the linearization k(P) (RayCat.pdAct_eq_zero_of_linPres): every relation of k(P) lifts along P̃ → P to relations of P̃ from each start point, and convexity keeps the lifts inside S. This is the kills condition of covering data with a Kronecker pair.
